items: Search our knowledge base for common solutions
Provide detailed steps to reproduce the issue
Include screenshots or error messages when applicable
Select the appropriate category and priority level
Check your email for ticket updates and responses
How do I reset my password? - Visit the password reset page
How long does ticket resolution take? - Depends on priority (High: 4hrs, Medium: 24hrs, Low: 48hrs)
Can I track my ticket status? - Yes, visit My Tickets page
How do I escalate an urgent issue? - Select 'High' priority or contact support directly
